reviewFlags.issue: E90TEW2J82 is sold as 6526 (black glass, 250 W, 800 מק״ש) and as 6524 (white glass, 330 W). Confirm the catalog's black 250 W entry is the 6526 variant.
The catalog says 2 LED bulbs 1.5 W. The Israeli retailer and the comparison listing say halogen (תאורת הלוגן). The manufacturer page does not state the lighting type.
The catalog says wall-mounted (צמוד קיר) and inclined. The fetched pages do not confirm mounting or inclined design. Midea English page says White Collection while Midea Israel says Black Collection.
The catalog says about 60 dB. Midea Israel says 64 dB(A).
The catalog says 2 LED bulbs of 1.5 W. Bug and Zap say halogen with 2 bulbs of 15 W. The manufacturer page does not say, so this needs checking.
E90TEW2J82 is also sold as 6524 (white glass, 330 W). Confirm that the catalog entry is the black 6526 unit.
No source confirms the wall-mounted or inclined design. The Midea English page reportedly says White Collection, while Midea Israel says Black Collection.
The catalog says about 60 dB. Research reports 64 dB(A) on Midea Israel, but no quote was provided for it.
